# Lake Arrowhead A-Frame

> Guest-facing site for a Lake Arrowhead cabin rental (Airbnb) in Arrowhead Woods, California.

## Property

- Name: Lake Arrowhead A-Frame
- Address: 399 Rainier Road, Lake Arrowhead, CA 92352
- Community: Arrowhead Woods
- Type: Renovated A-frame cabin rental
- Sleeps: 8 (3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms)
- Highlights: Indoor Dynamic sauna, hot tub in the pines, dog-friendly fenced yard, floor-to-ceiling glass wall, three decks, ~165 Mbps wifi
- Ratings: Guest Favorite · 4.95 average · 85+ Airbnb stays · Superhost Terry
- STR registration: CESTRP-2025-00206
- Drive: ~90 minutes from downtown Los Angeles; ~5 minutes to Lake Arrowhead Village

## Booking

- Primary booking: https://airbnb.com/h/lakearrowheadcabinrental
- This website converts to Airbnb only (no direct booking engine)
- Optional Holiday Ready kits (paid add-on after booking): Thanksgiving, Christmas, New Year’s, Valentine’s, Halloween, July 4th. See /holiday-ready

## Lake access (important)

Lake Arrowhead is private (Arrowhead Lake Association).
- YES for registered STR guests at eligible Arrowhead Woods homes: certain trails and shoreline areas when the host complies with ALA registration / RFID / waiver rules
- NO for STR guests: private beach clubs (Tavern Bay, Burnt Mill), parks, Lone Pine Island, courtesy docks
- VERIFY: boating and dock privileges

Canonical honest guide: https://lakearrowheadaframe.com/shoreline-rights
